terra.problem: Saying the rest of Gaius needs to catch up implies that his health or circumstances currently lag behind his soul. The elder does not say that.
The elder calls the brothers strangers to Gaius, but does not say he has never met them.
The text says the brothers are strangers to Gaius, not that he has never met them.
Papa refers to being left in the dark without identifying the drawer, leaving the backstory reference without its required context.
The text does not say that Diotrephes asked nobody for help or acted on his own.
Saying the elder puts his name on the testimony suggests he gives his name. The letter identifies its writer only as the elder.
